notes.title: OCEAN CITY RACING: Redux Is Now Available!
notes.content:
The [i]popular open world driving game[/i] features multiple game modes and offers total freedom to it's players!

[list]
    [*][b]FREE ROAM MODE:[/b] Explore Ocean City in it’s full detail by allowing you to exit vehicles and walk around on foot.
    [*] [b]RACE MODE:[/b] Drive your way through the thrilling events and unlock new vehicles as you progress.
    [*][b]TIME-TRIAL MODE:[/b] Beat the clock while driving at exciting tracks that also includes off-road and in-door environments.
[/list] 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oz8xXO2GzM4qxwrQI/giphy.gif[/img]

[b][url=http://store.steampowered.com//app/311400] => Get It Now for $2.99 on STEAM <=[/url][/b]

[i]OCEAN CITY RACING[/i] has been updated with improved graphics and environment quality, a brand new map area, new mini games and with the ability to control a new type of “vehicle”.


[b]OCEAN CITY RACING: Redux Feature List[/b]

•	Brand New Map Area in Free Roam Mode to Explore
•	Improved Vehicle Handling
•	Drifting is now easier to kick off
•	New Mini Games Including Car Football and Car Skating
•	New Stunt Locations
•	New “Controllable” Vehicle Type: Bear
•	Improved Graphics Quality and Post Process Effects
•	Improved Environment Quality
•	Improved Pedestrian Animation Quality
•	Destructible Traffic Lights and Street Lights in Free Roam Mode
•	Improved Draw Distance
•	Improved Traffic Density
•	Improved Overall Texture Quality
•	Reduced Music Sound and Addition of Dynamic Sound System
•	Improved In Game UI Messages
•	Improved Overall Optimisation

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l0HlO1cP91zI0ErW8/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Open World Exploration , Thrilling Races , Unique Time Trial Events - Update Plans of OCEAN CITY RACING
notes.content:
[b][url=http://store.steampowered.com//app/311400] => Get It Now for $2.99 on STEAM <=[/url][/b]

Featuring an [b]open world free roam sandbox mode[/b] ,  [b]time-trial- stunt mode[/b] and a [b]race mode[/b] on a massive environment , Ocean City Racing offers hours of entertainment for only $2.99 on STEAM.

[img]http://s18.postimg.org/xrgusttsp/ocr_steam299.jpg[/img]

OCEAN CITY RACING is filled with unique vehicles , only waiting for you to find and try them out. It is up to you to either explore the open world of Ocean City and find the secret vehicles such as the quad bike , or wait until you progress at the time-trial and race modes to unlock your new cool vehicle!
Play now to explore the world of OCEAN CITY!
[b][url=http://store.steampowered.com//app/311400] => Get it now for $2.99 on STEAM <=[/url][/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Ma2VD2q.gif[/img]

[b][url=http://youtu.be/5TvQCV_9E7g] Watch STEAM Launch Trailer OCR [/url][/b]

[b]What Will 2015 Bring to Ocean City Racing? [/b]
First off all i would like to thank everyone who purchased , played and gave feedback on OCEAN CITY RACING. I have received many great ideas , thoughts about the game that worked very hard to create. While i would love to implement all these great ideas , my hands are tied as i am the only person who is involved with the project from day one.

My current goal is to bring OCEAN CITY RACING to more gamers. To accomplish this , a Mac OS X version is being planned to be released on 2015 to Mac users who are looking for an old-school new generation open world driving experience!

[img]http://oceancitygame.com/gifocr.gif[/img]

Share this post to make sure your friends know about OceanCityRacing too!
